content: Next.js 16 (docs v16.3.4, lastUpdated 2026-03-18) still supports typescript.ignoreBuildErrors; default is false and next build fails on TypeScript errors by default. The typecheck flip is therefore: delete the typescript:{ignoreBuildErrors:true} block from next.config.ts (or set false) after fixing all errors; an explicit tsc --noEmit script remains valuable for fast pre-build feedback. next.config.js/.mjs/.ts precedence — stale duplicate config files must be deleted in the same change. Source: nextjs.org/learn/typescript or app docs fetched 2026-09-10.
